use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Math

union Middle is
    DIGITS(value: string) default
    REFUSED(reason: string)
si

middle_three(value: int) -> Middle is
    let digits = "{Math.abs(cast long(value))}"

    if digits.length < 3 then
        return Middle.REFUSED("fewer than three digits")
    fi

    if digits.length % 2 == 0 then
        return Middle.REFUSED("an even number of digits has no middle")
    fi

    return Middle.DIGITS(digits.substring(digits.length / 2 - 1, 3))
si

for value in [
    123, 12345, 1234567, 987654321, 10001, -10001, -123, -100, 100, -12345,
    1, 2, -1, -10, 2002, -2002, 0
] do
    let answer = middle_three(value)

    if answer? then
        write_line("{value,10}: {answer!}")
    elif let refused: Middle.REFUSED = answer then
        write_line("{value,10}: {refused.reason}")
    fi
